source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
A unit embarked in a **TRANSPORT** model on the battlefield can make a **Disembark Move**, unless it embarked this phase or that **TRANSPORT** has Advanced or Fallen Back this phase. Before setting it up per Set Up (03.02), pick the mode:

1. **Rapid Disembark**, if the **TRANSPORT** made a **normal move** or **ingress move** earlier in this phase.
2. Otherwise **Tactical Disembark**, if the **TRANSPORT** **remained stationary** or is still unselected for movement this phase, and the unit can be set up as required.
3. Otherwise **Combat Disembark**; each model first takes a **hazard roll**.

Set up every model wholly within 3″ of the **TRANSPORT**, or 6″ for Combat Disembark. While setting up:

- Rapid Disembark: if the **TRANSPORT** arrived this turn by ingress move, its models follow the rules the **TRANSPORT** followed in that move.
- Combat Disembark: models may start **engaged** with enemy units the **TRANSPORT** is engaged with.

Afterwards:

- Rapid Disembark: the unit cannot declare a charge this turn.
- Tactical Disembark: the unit is selected to make an advance or normal move.
- Combat Disembark: the unit becomes **battle-shocked** and cannot declare a charge this turn.
